verdict.rationale: Amplitude's APIs support some batch-style operations (bulk event export/ingest via HTTP V2 endpoint, cohort export/upload, Experiment APIs for managing flags across CI/scripts), which could be leveraged for bulk operations, but there is no documented feature explicitly for bulk operations across many items (e.g., batch-editing multiple cohorts, flags, or dashboards at once) framed for AI-native/automation use. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation endpoints or docs (batch update/delete across many entities), evidence of scale limits, and independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows.
